==English== {{swp}} [[File:Seagull wing.jpg|thumb|A [[laughing gull]] with its wings extended in the [[gullwing]] profile]] [[File:swan.spreads.wings.arp.jpg|thumb|right|A [[mute swan]] spreads its wings.]] [[File:bmi a319-100 g-dbca closeup arp.jpg|thumb|right|The wing of a landing BMI [[Airbus]] A319-100. The [[slat]]s at its [[leading edge]] and the [[flap]]s at its [[trailing edge]] are extended.]] [[File:(MHNT) Cirsium vulgare with Deraeocoris olivaceus.jpg |thumb|right|The winged stem of {{taxfmt|Cirsium vulgare|species}}.]] [[File:West facade of the Sully Wing, Louvre 31 May 2006 001.jpg|right|thumb|A building with two '''wings''']] ===Etymology=== {{root|en|ine-pro|*h₂weh₁-}} {{ety|en|:inh|enm:winge|tree=1}} From {{inh|en|enm|winge}}, {{m|enm|wenge}}, from {{der|en|non|vængr}} {{gl|"wing of a flying animal, wing of a building"; compare {{m|non|vængi|t=ship's cabin}}}}, from {{der|en|gem-pro|*wēingijaz}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*h₂weh₁-|t=to blow}}, thus related to {{m|en|wind}}. Cognate with {{cog|da,nb,sv|vinge||wing}}, {{cog|ovd|waingg||wing}}, {{cog|fo|vongur||wing}}, {{cog|is|vængur||wing}}, {{cog|nn|veng||wing}}. Replaced native {{ncog|enm|fither}} (from {{ncog|ang|fiþre}}, from {{ncog|gem-pro|*fiþriją}}), which merged with {{m+|enm|fether}} (from {{m+|ang|feþer}}, from {{cog|gem-pro|*feþrō}}). More at {{m|en|feather}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{enPR|wĭng|a=RP,GA}}; {{IPA|en|/wɪŋ/}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-wing.ogg|a=US}} ** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Back ache-wing.wav|a=UK}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈwɪŋɡ/|a=Northern England,Midlands,non-ng-coalescence}} * {{rhymes|en|ɪŋ|s=1}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun|~}} # {{senseid|en|Q161358}}{{lb|en|zootomy}} An [[appendage]] of an [[animal]]'s (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly. #: {{ux|en|The bird was flapping its '''wings'''}} # A [[fin]] at the side of a [[ray]] or similar fish. # {{senseid|en|arm}} {{lb|en|slang}} Human [[arm]]. # {{lb|en|aviation}} Part of an [[aircraft]] that produces the lift for rising into the air. #: {{ux|en|I took my seat on the plane, overlooking the '''wing'''.}} # One of the large [[pectoral]] [[fin]]s of a [[flying fish]]. # One of the broad, thin, [[anterior]] [[lobe]]s of the foot of a [[pteropod]], used as an [[organ]] in swimming. # {{lb|en|botany}} Any [[membranaceous]] expansion, such as that along the sides of certain stems, or one of the [[bract]]s on a [[dragon fruit]], or of a fruit of the kind called [[samara]]. # {{lb|en|botany}} Either of the two side [[petal]]s of a [[papilionaceous]] [[flower]]. # A side shoot of a tree or plant; a branch growing up by the side of another. # Passage by flying; flight. #: {{ux|en|to take '''wing'''}} #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Macbeth|III|ii|passage=Light thickens; and the crow / Makes '''wing''' to the rooky wood.}} # Limb or instrument of flight; means of flight or of rapid motion. #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Richard 3|IV|iii|passage=Fiery expedition be my '''wing'''.}} # A part of something that is lesser in size than the main body, and located at the side, such as an [[extension]] from the main building. #: {{ux|en|the west '''wing''' of the hospital}} #: {{ux|en|the '''wings''' of a corkscrew}} # {{lb|en|figurative}} Either of two similar parts of something. #* {{RQ:Bramah Max Carrados Mysteries|passage=Before going any farther on a wild goose chase I should advise you to verify the admitted American influence in the affair as connectible with Rigby Lacksome {{...}}. Until that point is settled both '''wings''' of your deductions are purely in the air.}} # One of the longer sides of [[crownwork]]s or [[hornwork]]s in [[fortification]]. # {{lb|en|slang|MLE}} {{ellipsis of|en|[[prison]] [[wing]]}}, a [[cellblock]]; or [[prison]] or [[do time|doing time]] by extension. # Anything that agitates the air as a wing does, or is put in winglike motion by the action of the air, such as a fan or vane for winnowing grain, the vane or sail of a windmill, the sail of a ship, etc. #* {{RQ:Tennyson In Memoriam|IX||Fair ship, that from the Italian shore,
⁠Sailest the placid ocean-plains
⁠With my lost Arthur’s loved remains,
Spread thy full '''wings''', and waft him o’er.}} # {{C|en|Diapers}} A protruding piece of material on a menstrual [[pad]] or [[diaper]] to hold it in place and prevent [[leakage]]. #* {{quote-book|en|year=2017|author=Laura Bates|title=Girl Up|page=8 |passage=It's a bit annoying but (like sanitary pads with '''wings''') it's worth it if you want to stay extra secure.}} # An ornament worn on the shoulder; a small [[epaulet]] or shoulder knot. # A [[cosmetic]] effect where [[eyeliner]] curves outward and ends at a point. # A faction of a [[political]] movement. Usually implies a position apart from the mainstream [[center]] position. # An organizational grouping in a [[military]] [[aviation]] service: ## {{lb|en|British}} A unit of command consisting of two or more [[squadron]]s and itself being a sub-unit of a [[group]] or [[station]]. ## {{lb|en|US}} A larger formation of two or more groups, which in turn control two or more squadrons. # {{lb|en|British}} A panel of a car which encloses the wheel area, especially the front wheels. # {{lb|en|nautical}} A [[platform]] on either side of the [[bridge]] of a [[vessel]], normally found in pairs. # {{lb|en|nautical}} That part of the [[hold]] or [[orlop]] of a vessel which is nearest the sides.
